status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Merti.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Merti.

summary.en: Ethiopian military drones have entered Sudan, prompting formal complaints from Sudan at the UN and the African Union, while RSF drones are being launched from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets. In northern Ethiopia, WHO warns the health system is near collapse as attacks on civilians continue, including an RPG strike near a school in Moyale that killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers and forced Kenya to register over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees. Sudan has accused Ethiopia of allowing RSF drone launches, and both countries have shut each other's consulates. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske militærdroner har gått inn i Sudan, noe som har ført til formelle klager fra Sudan til FN og Den afrikanske union, mens RSF-droner blir lansert fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål. I Nord-Etiopia advarer WHO om at helsesystemet er nær kollaps ettersom angrep på sivile fortsetter, inkludert et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale som drepte 60 etiopiske ortodokse troende og tvang Kenya til å registrere over 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger. Sudan har anklaget Etiopia for å tillate RSF-droneoppskytinger, og begge land har stengt hverandres konsulater. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in Amhara
background.extract: The War in Amhara is an armed war and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
